texto: To indicate the street in which you live, you usually say «Ik woon op...» or «in de...» followed by the name of the track and the number. In the Netherlands the portal number is always written after the street name («Marktstraat 12»). The people and language names are always written with initial capital in Dutch: «Spaans», «Nederlands».

frases.en: What street do you live on?

frases.nl: Ik woon op de Marktstraat, nummer twaalf.
Ik ben Spaans, maar ik woon nu in België.
frases.es: Soy española, pero ahora vivo en Bélgica.
frases.en: I'm Spanish, but now I live in Belgium.

opciones.texto: First the street name and then the portal number
First the portal number and then the street with a coma
opciones.explicacion: This format corresponds to the Anglo-Saxon standard, not the Dutch one.

opciones.explicacion: The name of the street followed by the portal is always disclosed.

opciones.explicacion: «In welke straat» specifically asks about the street.

opciones.texto: The country of origin in which he was born.
opciones.explicacion: He is not asking about the country of birth, but about the current street.

opciones.texto: How many years have you been residing in Belgium.
opciones.explicacion: He does not ask about the duration of your stay.

«Straat» would mean street, but they've consulted her before.

bloques.frase: Ik ben Spaans, maar ik woon nu in België.

opciones.texto: He is a Spanish national but currently resides in Belgium.
opciones.explicacion: «Spaans» indicates its origin and «in België» its present residence.

opciones.texto: He is of Belgian nationality and is going to live in Spain.
opciones.explicacion: It inverts the relationship: it is Spanish that lives in Belgium.

opciones.texto: He works as a Spanish teacher in the Netherlands.
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't mention his teaching profession.

bloques.frase: Ik woon op de Marktstraat, nummer ___.

opciones.explicacion: «Twaalf» is the number twelve in Dutch.
«Twee» means two, while she indicates the twelve.

bloques.traduccion: What street do you live on?
bloques.explicacion: Ask with composite question and verb conjugated in formal investment with «u».
